Around 1993/12

blocks.source: 物語
blocks.translation: Story

blocks.source: 皇帝と七英雄の戦いという流れで、話の筋がしっかり通っている。ロマサガ１・３では、何だか良く分からないうちにラスボスと戦うことになっていたけれど、それと比較して戦う目的が明確。
blocks.translation: The story follows the battle between the emperor and the Seven Heroes, and its narrative is tightly constructed. In Romancing SaGa 1 and 3, you ended up fighting the final boss before you really knew what was going on, but here the purpose of the battle is clear by comparison.

blocks.source: そして、フリーシナリオによる自由度が高く多彩なストーリー。自由度は高いけれど、七英雄を倒すという目的がしっかりしているので、「何をすれば良いのか分からない」となって戸惑うことは少ないと思う。自由度がありながらも、放置では無く目的がしっかりしているというバランスが肝。
blocks.translation: It also offers a diverse story with a high degree of freedom through its free-scenario system. Although the freedom is extensive, the goal of defeating the Seven Heroes is clear, so I doubt players will often feel confused and wonder, “What am I supposed to do?” The key is the balance between freedom and having a clear purpose rather than simply being left on your own.

blocks.source: 『運河要塞』『カンバーランド』『地上戦艦』など、複数の展開・解決策を持ったイベントが多くある。『冥術』『皇帝コッペリア』など、隠し要素も豊富。普通に一度やっただけでは逃してしまいそうな要素の数々が魅力的。
blocks.translation: There are many events with multiple possible developments and solutions, such as “Canal Fortress,” “Cumberland,” and “Landship.” There are also plenty of hidden elements, including “Dark Arts” and “Emperor Coppelia.” The many elements that you could easily miss by playing through only once are part of the game's appeal.

blocks.source: システム／バランス／快適性
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance / Comfort

blocks.source: 『継承』『陣形』『閃き』など多くの新システムが登場。
blocks.translation: Many new systems make their debut, including “Succession,” “Formations,” and “Sparks.”

blocks.source: 『新システム』と銘打ったものは奇抜なだけで別に面白くも何ともないというのは、ありがちな話。しかし、この作品ではそれらのシステムが確実に面白さにつながっている。特に『陣形』『閃き』などは、以降のシリーズ作品でもお馴染みの要素となった。
blocks.translation: It is common for things labeled as “new systems” to be merely eccentric without being interesting at all. In this game, however, these systems unquestionably contribute to its enjoyment. “Formations” and “Sparks” in particular became familiar features in later entries in the series.

blocks.source: ボス戦は非常に手応えがあって、特に様々な個性を持った七英雄との戦いが熱い。
blocks.translation: The boss battles offer a great deal of challenge, and the battles against the Seven Heroes, each with their own distinct personalities, are especially intense.

blocks.source: 「サガシリーズといえばボス戦」というイメージがあるけれど、ボス戦重視が明確に打ち出されたのは今作が初めて。その意味でも、サガシリーズのゲームデザインを決定した作品といえる。
blocks.translation: There is an image of “boss battles being what the SaGa series is all about,” but this is the first game in which that emphasis was made explicit. In that sense, it can be called the game that defined the SaGa series' game design.

blocks.source: ただし、ラスボスが異常に強く、消費は大きいが敵の動きを止める『クイックタイム』によるハメ殺しで倒すのが定番になってしまっている。正攻法で戦うと普通のゲームの裏ボス以上の難易度になるので難しい。補助技を使いこなせば倒せるらしいが、筆者はやったことが無い。
blocks.translation: However, the final boss is abnormally strong, and defeating it by locking it down with “Quick Time,” which consumes a great deal of resources but stops the enemy's actions, has become the standard strategy. Fighting it legitimately raises the difficulty above that of an ordinary game's secret boss, making it extremely difficult. Apparently, it can be defeated by mastering support techniques, but I have never done so myself.
Addendum (2017/9/12)

blocks.source: 今更ながらラスボスを正攻法で撃破したので、ひっそりと追記。
blocks.translation: I finally defeated the final boss legitimately, so I am quietly adding this note.

blocks.source: 戦法は最初の数ターンで補助術を全員にかけて、強い技で攻撃するだけ。何度か試してみたけど、回復を縛っても高確率で勝てるほど。極端なレベル上げも不要で、今までの苦労が不思議なくらいだった。
blocks.translation: The strategy is simply to cast support spells on everyone during the first few turns, then attack with powerful techniques. I tried it several times, and it was possible to win with a high probability even while restricting healing. Extreme level grinding was unnecessary, making all the trouble I had gone through before seem almost absurd.

blocks.source: そうして分かったのは、ロマサガ２の難易度を上げているのは隠しデータの多さと不親切さ。
blocks.translation: What I realized was that what makes Romancing SaGa 2 difficult is the abundance of hidden data and its lack of helpfulness.

blocks.source: 装備の表示性能と実態が一致していない。防御力１の装備品が高性能だったりする一方で、最強の帽子のように表示だけは優秀な罠装備まである。
blocks.translation: The displayed performance of equipment does not match its actual performance. Some equipment with a defense rating of 1 is surprisingly effective, while there are also trap items whose displayed stats are excellent, such as the supposedly strongest hat.

blocks.source: 弓や小剣のように育てても強くならない武器がある。また、後半のボス戦で実用に耐える攻撃術は二つしかない。水、風、地の術レベルをいくら上げても攻撃役としては不足。
blocks.translation: Some weapons, such as bows and small swords, do not become stronger no matter how much you develop them. In addition, only two offensive spells are practical in the latter half's boss battles. No matter how much you raise your Water, Wind, or Earth spell levels, they are insufficient for an attacker.

blocks.source: キャラクター毎に閃ける技が決まっている。剣が得意と自称しているキャラでも、線斬りや残像剣すら閃けないことがある。最後まで半端な技で挑まされる可能性も。
blocks.translation: The techniques each character can Spark are predetermined. Even a character who claims to be good with swords may be unable to Spark even Whirlwind or Mirage Blade. You may end up having to face the final battles with mediocre techniques.

blocks.source: 後半は術が重要になるが、中盤まではまともな攻撃術がなく育てるのが大変。補助術は強力だが、そもそも効果に気づかない可能性も。
blocks.translation: Spells become important in the latter half, but there are no decent offensive spells until the middle of the game, making them difficult to develop. Support spells are powerful, but you may not even realize what their effects are.

blocks.source: 陣形効果も秘密だらけ。例えば、一見強力なラピッドストリームだが、先制の特性を除けば能力補正は最悪。何も考えずボス戦で使うと難易度が上がる。
blocks.translation: Formation effects are also full of secrets. For example, Rapid Stream looks powerful at first glance, but its ability modifiers are terrible apart from its first-strike property. Using it thoughtlessly in boss battles only increases the difficulty.

blocks.source: さらにラスボス戦では……
blocks.translation: Furthermore, in the final boss battle…

blocks.source: 特定の技の見切りがほぼ必須だが、プレイスタイル次第では持っていない可能性も。
blocks.translation: Evading certain techniques is almost essential, but depending on your play style, you may not have learned them.

blocks.source: 術の開発や装備の量産化には、時間経過が必要。ラスボス直前になってはもう手遅れ。
blocks.translation: Developing spells and mass-producing equipment requires time to pass. If you wait until just before the final boss, it is already too late.

blocks.source: 混乱や魅了による同士討ち対策として、全体攻撃技は封印しておく必要がある。これによりラスボス戦で実用に耐える攻撃術はクリムゾンフレアのみとなる。
blocks.translation: To prevent allies from attacking one another due to confusion or charm, you need to seal away area-of-effect techniques. As a result, Crimson Flare is the only offensive spell practical in the final boss battle.

blocks.source: というように罠のオンパレードになっている。
blocks.translation: In other words, the game is a parade of traps.

blocks.source: 逆に言えば、仕様をある程度理解していれば、ロマサガ２はそこまで難しいゲームではない。これまで、ラスボスは強すぎるのではないか――と、思っていたのだけど、ゲームシステムの理解を前提にすれば、これぐらいが妥当と制作者が考えたのも納得できた。
blocks.translation: Conversely, if you understand the mechanics to some extent, Romancing SaGa 2 is not actually that difficult a game. I had always thought the final boss might be too strong, but assuming an understanding of the game system, I can appreciate why the developers considered this level of difficulty appropriate.

blocks.source: もっとも、さすがに制作者も反省したらしく、ロマサガ３ではこれらが大幅に緩和されている。
blocks.translation: That said, the developers apparently reflected on these issues, because they were greatly eased in Romancing SaGa 3.

blocks.source: 以上、追記終わり。
blocks.translation: That concludes the addendum.

blocks.source: 今作もシンボルエンカウントを採用しているが、前作『ロマンシングサガ』のようにうじゃうじゃと敵がいるわけでは無いので安心。シンボルエンカウントゆえの快適感を、まともに感じられるようになったのはこの作品から。
blocks.translation: This game also uses symbol encounters, but thankfully it does not have enemies swarming everywhere like its predecessor, Romancing SaGa. This is the game where symbol encounters finally began to provide a genuinely comfortable experience.

blocks.source: また、戦闘終了後にHPが全回復するようになったのも、この作品から。代わりに導入されたのが『LP』。HPが０になる度にキャラが保有するLPが減り、０になるとキャラが消滅する。といっても、それほど厳しい制約では無い。実はGBの初代魔界塔士サガに似たようなハート制というものがあったので、復古という感じである。
blocks.translation: This is also the game that introduced the recovery of all HP after battle. In its place, “LP” was introduced. Each time a character's HP reaches 0, their LP decreases, and when it reaches 0, the character disappears. Even so, this is not an especially harsh restriction. In fact, the original SaGa for the Game Boy had a similar heart system, so this feels like a revival of that idea.

blocks.source: 高めの難易度ながら、『どこでもセーブ』『Ｘボタンで町から脱出できる』などの親切設計も目立つ。個人的には「難しい作品ほど親切であれ」と思っているので、これはありがたい。
blocks.translation: Despite its relatively high difficulty, it also stands out for its considerate design, such as “saving anywhere” and “being able to escape towns with the X button.” Personally, I believe that the more difficult a game is, the more considerate it should be, so I appreciate this.

blocks.source: なお、どこでもセーブにありがちな欠点として、ハマりが挙げられる。しかし、この作品では基本的に全滅しても『継承』によって、別のキャラに皇帝の座を引き継ぐことができる。ゲームオーバーにはならないので、ハマリの危険性は少ない。ただし、ラスボス手前でハマり（裏技的に脱出可能）があるので注意。
blocks.translation: One common drawback of saving anywhere is the possibility of getting stuck. In this game, however, even if your entire party is wiped out, “Succession” generally allows another character to inherit the emperor's throne. Since it does not result in a game over, the risk of getting stuck is low. Be careful, though: it is possible to get stuck just before the final boss, although you can escape using a glitch-like trick.

blocks.source: 気になったところでは、戦闘テンポが意外と悪いところ。いちいち技名やダメージ表示に間があるので、時間がかかる。当時、気にならなかったのは短期決戦型の戦闘バランスのお陰かもしれない。
blocks.translation: One thing that bothered me was that the battle tempo is unexpectedly poor. There is a pause every time a technique name or damage amount is displayed, which makes battles take a long time. The fact that this did not bother me at the time may have been thanks to the short-battle-oriented balance.

blocks.source: また、年代が進むごとにパーティーを１から再編成する必要がある。今回はどんな構成にしようかというのは楽しい悩みでもあるけれど、面倒なのも確か。
blocks.translation: In addition, you need to rebuild your party from scratch each time the era advances. Deciding what kind of party to create this time is an enjoyable dilemma, but it is certainly a hassle as well.

blocks.source: 特に術を習得する度に、メニューが閉じる仕様は時代を考えても劣悪な操作性。装備の開発を行うためには、城内までマメに戻る必要があったりと、今にしてみれば面倒なところは多い。
blocks.translation: In particular, the way the menu closes every time you learn a spell makes for terrible controls, even considering the era. Developing equipment also requires you to frequently return all the way to the castle, among many other things that feel cumbersome in retrospect.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: 伊藤賢治氏は戦闘曲に定評あり。後の作品と比較すると、戦闘曲の数は少ないが安心のクオリティ。手応えのあるボス戦を大いに盛り上げる。評価が最も高いのは七英雄戦だろうか。「このボスは今までのザコとは違う」というプレッシャーも得られて印象深い。
blocks.translation: Kenji Ito is renowned for his battle music. Compared with later games, there are fewer battle themes, but the quality is reliably excellent. They greatly heighten the excitement of the challenging boss battles. The Seven Heroes battle theme may be the most highly regarded. It also creates the memorable pressure of realizing, “This boss is different from the ordinary enemies we've faced so far.”

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Summary

blocks.source: 難易度はやや高めなのだが『どこでもセーブ』『シンボルエンカウント』などで快適設計がされている。なので、難易度の割りにはそれ程の疲れは感じない。ゲーム性重視のプレイヤーなら、やっておくべき作品。
blocks.translation: The difficulty is somewhat high, but features such as “Save Anywhere” and “Symbol Encounters” make for a comfortable experience. As a result, it does not feel particularly tiring despite the difficulty. Players who prioritize gameplay should definitely give this title a try.
